mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sell_order (inbound_detail_id, sell_qty, base_price, settlement_fx_rate, status, processed_at) VALUES (#{inboundDetailId}, #{sellQty}, #{basePrice}, #{settlementFxRate}, #{status}, #{processedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.order_id, s.inbound_detail_id, s.sell_qty, s.base_price, s.settlement_fx_rate, s.status, s.processed_at FROM sell_order s JOIN inbound_detail id ON s.inbound_detail_id = id.inbound_detail_id JOIN inbound i ON id.inbound_id = i.inbound_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId}
